blocks.text: The Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) collects and correlates security data and business context from a wide range of external tools, such as vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, and cloud providers. To begin ingesting this data into your environment, you must first connect the relevant sources to your account. Establishing these connections ensures that the Agentic SecOps Platform can continuously retrieve and normalize data for analysis, prioritization, and workflows.

Before you create a source, see Deploying Data Source Configurations for deployment prerequisites, setup considerations, and planning guidance. To identify the available sources, supported streams, and source-specific configuration requirements, see Agentic Security Operations Platform Configurations by Data Source.
This article explains how to create a new data source. For information on managing existing sources, see Managing Data Sources.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Sources.
A list of all existing sources appears.
Select a source from the available tiles. You can also search for a source in the search field.

You can connect a generic AnySource connector, which allows you to upload or extract files from data storage platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS S3. To learn more, see Connecting AnySource.
On the source setup page, configure the setup in the following sections:
(Optional) Click Test to verify the source's authentication and connectivity.
Click Save to save the data source.

blocks.text: Saving the source redirects you to the Sources page, where all connected sources are listed. Your new data is retrieved on the next data run. To retrieve the data immediately, hover over the source and click the Process Now icon.

To ensure the data can be correctly processed and used across the Agentic SecOps Platform, you must configure field mappings. Hover over the newly added source and click Map Data to map source fields to the corresponding Agentic SecOps Platform fields. To learn more, see Mapping Data Sources and Using Mapping Copilot.
